column3: Saori Route ・ Kyousuke-shi's Sermon
...I am really glad you feel that way.
But right now, your words are too heavy...
I've gone this far... you think I'll just give up now...!
I have to do something to get her to listen to me...
If my words are too heavy for you, then I'll carry half for you.
That's why... that's why, please... won't you at least hear me out?
...Kyousuke-shi...
Why are you going this far for me...
I know why you care so much about your relationships.
You're a gentle and incredibly kind person.
No matter how you stand out, you reached out to my sister when she was being shunned and you worried about that delusional girl.
Whenever your friends are troubled, you try to help them no matter what... That's a lot more impressive than you think.
Kyousuke-shi, you are praising me a bit too much... I was merely doing the obvious thing to do.
Like I'm saying, the fact you think it's obvious when it isn't! It's amazing!
I definitely could not run a community. I also couldn't mediate Kirino and Kuroneko alone, either.
Do you see what I'm saying?
We need you. You're irreplaceable.
...But, that has been up 'til now.
Just earlier, Kiririn-shi obviously hated me.
Kirino didn't mean what she said. I can tell... I'm her brother, after all.
That's why you, who cares about other people's feelings, can do it-
...If that's the case, all the more reason I should leave.
Why! This doesn't make any sense!
Please understand, Kyousuke-shi. I do not want to be trouble to my friends.
I have always wanted to be a person whose friends regard myself as a friend.
Even after saying all that, Saori's resolve still hasn't wavered...
Which means, her will is strong.
But, there is one thing decisively wrong in what she is saying!
I understand that you think of us preciously.
...But, is that what a friend is?
Huh...?
A friend isn't just someone you go out together, shop, and have fun with, right?
Like Kirino and Kuroneko, they also fight, badmouth, and worry when one gets sick.
Good and bad things, fun and terrible things, all of these combined is what friends are about, right?
Causing trouble to your friends? Like I care! It'd be strange if there wasn't!
But, this is different from just causing trouble...
When your friends came to you for advice, did you think it was a bother? Of course not, right?
At the very least, I'll be happy. Coming to me for advice means that I'm being relied on, right?
I'll be so very happy when I think about the fact that I'm being relied on... This doesn't happen a lot, so cut me some slack.
That's why, when you came to me about your marriage interview, I was really happy.
Since we're always relying on you, it was nice that you relied on us as well.
But... I have not...
You did, Saori. Kirino, Kuroneko, and I, all of us unconsciously rely on you.
We have caused you a lot of "trouble." Not just once or twice, but all the time.
So don't think of it a being a bother! Tell me... your true feelings!
...It looks like she is trying to say something.
But from the way she is staying silent...
It's like the words are trying to escape her throat, but just can't come out... huh?
...Kyousuke-shi...
Saori, please.
I want to hear what you have to say.
But, but...
I do not know what to do anymore...!
I know how Saori feels. I know, but...!
But the way she denies everything won't solve anything...
Why can't she just understand that...
...Do you plan on running?
Bottling your feelings up, wanting to protect something precious as an excuse...
In the end, all you're doing is running away.
Doing exactly as your parents say, going off with your fiance, it's all too painful so you just run away!
Have you talked with your parents? Have you told your fiance how you really feel?!
...If I said that...!
S-Saori...?
Uuuu, *hic*...
N-No way... hey...
This is the first time I've seen Saori cry...
Saori... um, sorry...
I... said too much...right?
No... I'm sorry too, suddenly crying like that...
But, that's who I am...
The real me is weak, small, and a cowardly girl...
Nothing can be done... I cannot do anything else...
Saori sobbed quietly, her voice shaking.
Not being able to find the words to fix this, I just stood there until she stopped...
You like being an otaku, right?
You love your figures, games, and manga so much you can't help it, right?
That is... true...
Lying about something you like, don't make me laugh by talking about the engagement!
Even if he's your fiance, he still doesn't deserve to call you his wife..
That can't be your reason to give up on what you like!!
...You're always like this, Saori.
You try to keep everything together by saying nice things, and make everyone happy while shutting yourself in...
You're a flower of a high schooler. You should be doing more things you want to.
...I've already done plenty of those now.
I'm saying selfish words even now, causing you a lot of trouble...
How is that enough!?
In fact, it's never enough! Make it 20% more!!
Actually, you need way more than enough! Show me 200% enough!!
Well, do what you want then.
I'm not you, so I can't understand you completely.
If what I said so far still can't shake your determination, then perhaps this is the best choice for you?
...If that's the case, I won't say anything more.
Kyousuke-shi...
...It's my honor to have received your understanding.
I can't accept it yet, though...
But, even if we appear to not be friends anymore, we're still friends forever!
Even I felt a bit embarrassed after saying that.
But it was how I felt, so I couldn't lie about it.
Well then... take care.
A few months later...
I received a letter and a photograph from Saori.
The letter was about her engagement on her birthday.
The reception was for relatives only, so Kirino, Kuroneko, and I couldn't go.
And the photo was-
A photo of Saori in a pure white wedding dress.
...She was beautiful.
She had a reserved smile on her face, but it had the feel of a princess.
It would be no exaggeration to call Saori a beauty.
But, what is this?
When I look at Saori's smiling face, my chest hurts.
It's embarrassing to say but, I'm so lonely, my chest feels like it will break.
This must be what it is like for a father to send out their daughter as a bride.
...Hey, Saori.
Was this... really okay?
Saori smiled with a lonely expression in the picture...
My body wont be able to hold all that...
If it's that much, you can do it! Right?
Haha... I don't even know.
It is just as you say, if I do as I please, I may be happy.
But, is that not any different than being a selfish child?
...She may be right.
But, that is not what I am trying to say to Saori.
Saori should live life more freely.
Not paying mind to obligations, living as she pleases.
Even if she's a reserved lady, her life doesn't need to be reserved as well.
The only thing that has to be reserved are figurines on pre-order.
I really have made great friends.
Kyousuke-shi, Kiririn-shi, Kuroneko-shi... My irreplaceable friends, I was able to make so many memories.
That is why, I am satisfied.
Saori declared in a distinctive tone.
...Are you fine like that?
Are you really, really fine?
Yes. It is fine the way it is.
Saori had a gentle expression, as her words flowed out her mouth...
As I tried to say something, I though about Saori's unwavering determination.
Wait... marriage is something both parties agree to, right?
If that's the case, if she had someone who already "made a promise to..."
Okay, I know! I'll marry you!
Wahhh...!!
K-K-K-K-Kyousuke-shi!? What are you saying!?
For the sake of throwing off the engagement!
It'll lower the chances of you getting another fiance, right?
B-But t-t-t-t-this is... umm, uhhh...
...After saying so much, you still don't get it?
As an outsider, I'm already this fired up! For the sake of my important friend, for the sake of you!
Now show me your willpower!
Fu... I understand.
If you say it like that, I can prepare myself for the worst.
Well, do what you want then.
Huh...?
I'm not you, so I can't understand you completely.
If what I said so far still can't shake your determination, then perhaps this is the best choice for you?
...If that's the case, I won't say anything more.
Kyousuke-shi...
...It's my honor to have received your understanding.
I can't accept it yet, though...
But, even if we appear to not be friends anymore, we're still friends forever!
Even I felt a bit embarrassed after saying that.
But it is how I felt, so I can't lie about my feelings.
Well then... take care.
A few months after...
I received a letter and a photograph from Saori.
The letter was about her engagement on her birthday.
The reception was for relatives only, so Kirino, Kuroneko, and I couldn't go.
And the photo was-
A photo of Saori in a pure white wedding dress.
...She was beautiful.
She had a reserved smile on her face, but it had the feel of a princess.
It would be no exaggeration to call Saori a beauty.
But, what is this?
When I look at Saori's smiling face, my chest hurts.
It's embarrassing to say but, I'm so lonely, my chest feels like it will break.
This must be what it is like for a father to send out their daughter as a bride.
...Hey, Saori.
Was this... really okay?
Saori smiled with a lonely expression in the picture...
Well...?
...Yes, I have gained the determination to decline the engagement.
I am an otaku. An otaku who does not feel shame for being one.
I will quit lying to myself. I love the things I have grown attached to. Nothing more, nothing less.
Such an obvious and important thing.... why haven't I noticed it all this while?
It's hard to realize because it is obvious... probably.
Because it is always there, you forget it is precious... kinda like air.
Hobbies and family... stuff like that, right?
Kirino, Kuroneko, and Saori are no doubt three pieces of my world that I cannot remove.
The same goes for my childhood friends, Manami and Ayase, my irreplaceable friends.
But even if I understand how important they are, if we hang around together long enough, I would take it for granted.
Yet, as soon as I couldn't contact Saori, I became really lonely.
That's when I knew.
The obvious isn't so obvious sometimes. It can easily be overlooked.
Seriously, your passion is admirable.
To be able to turn over my entire life's determination.
Your entire life? I may have done something bad.
Fufu, do not worry about it.
Before long, I believe I will find another lifetime's worth of determination.
What do you mean?
...It is a secret for now.
I don't know what's up but, she seems fine... right?
For now, what will you do?
First, I think I will have a talk with my parents.
Well, that's probably the best thing to do.
Even as I say that, they may go either way about accepting it...
Even if it does not work, I will not give up.
If once is not enough, I will do it twice, or thrice. If three times is not enough, I will do it any number of times.
...That way my "love" will get to them, right?
Yeah, just like that.
Fufufufu...
Thank you, Kyousuke-shi. I am grateful for everything...
If you are thanking me, then do it after. I'm waiting for the good news.
...Okay!
Oh yeah, my father said something like...
The misery of a child is a parent's responsibility.
Saori's parents might feel sorry about deciding their daughter's life by themselves.
Of course they will...
They will probably be relieved that she talked to them about it.
That's why you have to go and tell them everything you have been holding in.
Kyousuke-shi...
You are not just looking out for me, but my family as well?
Of course?
If it's your family, then they are related to your problem.
